declared_before: any production-scorer replay metric of any arm

finding_that_motivates_it.production_pmfs: 2026-27 persisted production PMFs (154,728 rows, 44 runs, incumbent): realized / PMF mean PTS low-minute (min_mu < 10) 0.728, bench 0.873; AST 0.752 / 0.907; FG3M 0.685 / 0.888; variance ratio PTS 0.95-1.08 (no dispersion defect visible)
finding_that_motivates_it.decomposition: PMF mean / marginal mean = 1.218 PTS, 1.125 AST, 1.267 FG3M for min_mu < 10 (1.00 for starters): JM1 (alpha = 1) propagates realized-minutes variation through log_minutes_ratio; realized minutes of deep-bench players exceed min_mu, so the full per-minute RATE over-forecast (~27% PTS) reaches the priced PMF
finding_that_motivates_it.consequence: the 2026-11-22 proxy scorer (NB at expected minutes, no minutes uncertainty) is not the production PMF. The 'PTS low-minute dispersion defect' was a proxy artifact; the A2 per-stat decisions must be re-tested on the PRODUCTION scorer

scorer: cbb_platform.v2.jm1_final_production.score_game (the production scorer, unmodified) with the frozen opening artifacts (prod.loader.load); PMF = its Rao-Blackwellized mixture_pmf; SIMS 2000 per game, common random numbers across arms (same game seeds)

datasets.F2026: v2.phase3.season_inputs(2026): point-in-time Phase 1B OOS candidate rows (state through 2024-25) + pregame environment; A2 inputs from D1 F2026 (joined on player_game_example_id)
datasets.LIVE: 2026-27 walk-forward rows through 2026-11-21 (opening-marginal OOS forecasts, frame hash = the 11-22 production manifest) + their team frame -> prod.inputs.environment

arms.A2: A2 means (frozen F2024+F2025 constants, CHALLENGER_A_PROTOCOL revision_A2, SCALE = L_A2 / L_incumbent) for all 7 stats

evaluation: played rows (y_min > 0), PMF conditional on playing; per stat: log score, RPS, calibration-in-the-large by role (min_mu <10 / 10-20 / 20-30 / 30+), early season (season_day <= 14); game-clustered paired SE

gate_per_stat.G1: F2026 and LIVE: d log loss (A2 - INC) upper bound (mean + 1.96 SE) < 0
gate_per_stat.G2: F2026: no role cell d log loss upper bound > +0.002
gate_per_stat.G3: LIVE: early-season (season_day <= 14) d log loss upper bound <= +0.0005
gate_per_stat.G4: LIVE: max |realized / PMF mean - 1| over roles decreases
gate_per_stat.decision: PROMOTE A2 for a stat iff G1-G4 pass; a promoted stat that FAILS here (AST / FG3M / STL) is ROLLED BACK to the incumbent rate

combos: PRA / PR / PA / RA / STOCKS are reported (from the same draws is not available in the mixture PMF; reported only through their component stats)
no_tuning: no parameter is fitted in Phase 4; the A2 constants are the frozen F2024+F2025 values already in production
